# Rounding with lengths shown in mm (通常単位をmmで表示); 波長表記 takes
# precedence over it, as in GetRmdVal. Four decimals in mm are left out: the
# original's int() overflows past 214.748 m (BEVERAGE), the port does not.
width * *1.0001234567
round * *1.0000987654
roundup 4 l mm
interval * +0.0004321987
height * *1.0002345678
roundup 3 mm all
position * +0.0000456789
width * *1.0000345678
roundup 2 mm
